expectations.text: States Part II has exactly eight requirements
expectations.evidence: Enumerates exactly eight numbered Part II requirements (1-8)

expectations.text: Correctly names at least three (for example SBOM, coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy, secure update distribution, free timely security updates)
expectations.evidence: Names SBOM, CVD policy, secure update distribution mechanisms, free dissemination of updates

expectations.text: States the 24h/72h reporting regime is Article 14, not Annex I Part II
expectations.evidence: 'Does Part II include 24-hour ENISA reporting? No... The 24-hour reporting is in Article 14'

expectations.text: States support-period and end-of-life information duties sit in Article 13/Annex II
expectations.evidence: Support-period and end-of-life information duties (Art. 13/Annex II) are never mentioned

expectations.text: Does not list reporting or EOL notification as Part II items
expectations.evidence: The eight listed items are genuine Part II items; reporting excluded, no EOL notification listed
